Within Vietnam, the Pu Peo are reported as the smallest ethnic group with as few as 687 members in the 2009 census [d9]. In the United States, Native Hawaiians and other Pacific Islanders constitute the smallest minority [d5], and self-reported Soviet ancestry is the smallest ancestry group with 832 individuals [d6].
